ground_truth_methodology.description: All 100 ground-truth relevance labels are defined by falsifiable physical predicates evaluated directly against the sensor telemetry data. Each query's relevance function is a boolean conjunction of measurable physical thresholds (e.g., Hs >= 3.5 m, site_id == 'duck_nc', timestamp BETWEEN '2012-10-27' AND '2012-10-31'). No subjective human relevance judgment is involved. Labels are fully reproducible by evaluating the predicate against the published Parquet files.
